qwen3.8-27b.name: Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M (coding + hard design — :8091, 262144 ctx, 1 slot)

build.description: Orchestrator. Routes work; does NOT do it. DO NOT add reasoningEffort:'none' here — measured 2026-08-05, it drops subagent dispatches to ZERO (the model stops deciding to delegate). The edit/write/patch/bash denials are load-bearing too: with prose alone the no-implementation rule held on some runs and not others.

planner.description: Produces an implementation plan from context provided in-prompt. Reasoning only.

architect.description: Designs structure and interfaces from provided context. Reasoning only. Shares mini:8091's single qwen3.8-27b slot with coder and deep, so a concurrent architect+deep dispatch queues.

coder.description: Implements changes. Edits files, verifies they parse/build. On mini:8091 qwen3.8-27b with architect — ONE slot shared with architect+deep, so a concurrent dispatch queues.

devops.description: Infra and shell operations. Deterministic, no reasoning.

reviewer.description: Critiques diffs handed to it. Reasoning only. FAN-OUT agent — dispatched in parallel with the other critics. Since 2026-08-14 the critics share :8090 with the orchestrator (4 slots), so a 4-wide fan-out fully occupies the endpoint and the orchestrator queues behind it.

security-auditor.description: Audits provided diffs for security issues. Reasoning only. FAN-OUT agent.

tester.description: Writes and runs tests, reads results. FAN-OUT agent.

doc-writer.description: Writes docs from provided material. Reasoning only. FAN-OUT agent.

qa.description: Final acceptance gate. Runs the delivered system against its DONE-WHEN list black-box, with real dependencies, and pastes actual output per criterion. Distinct from tester: tester proves the logic, qa proves the thing works. Runs AFTER the critic fan-out, not inside it. Runs ALONE, after the fan-out has drained. There is no longer a second endpoint to split across: the throughput endpoint was retired 2026-08-14 because :8090 with MTP beat it on BOTH aggregate and single-stream. Measured 2026-08-05: on gpt-oss-20b it spent 11 of 17 tool calls globbing and reading (which qa.md forbids) and never emitted its @@RESULT block at all, so the orchestrator improvised an extra tester dispatch that then hung the run.

librarian.description: Second brain. RECALL: searches the cortex vault for prior lessons before work starts. CAPTURE: records a lesson after a run with a real miss. The ONLY agent with vault tools — the orchestrator is denied them, because measured 2026-08-05 a prose "cortex pass" never fired once while a dispatch does.

deep.description: Hard problems only. qwen3.8-27b on :8091 — ONE slot; a second dispatch queues behind it.

research.description: Tier X. Live web research via xAI. NEVER give this agent client-confidential material.
